title: Ollie, a privacy-focused AI assistant, is shutting down
summary: As an increasing number of AI assistants flood the market, the founder of Ollie, an assistant that respected its users' privacy, says it will be shutting down in a week.
reason: Item reports a privacy-focused AI assistant shutting down. It is not a model release, research artifact, policy action, or OSS tool launch, and group 3 covers financing, M&A, partnerships, market data, or product launches — not a shutdown. No rule covers it.
